svg.title: How much of a shaking finger survives the filter
svg.desc: one-euro, frozen at four operating points, at the recordings' median 32 ms frame (31.2 FPS)
svg.text: How much of a shaking finger survives the filter
one-euro, frozen at four operating points, at the recordings' median 32 ms frame (31.2 FPS)
old EMA, same at every speed
speeds, from the filter's own estimate: still median 124, moving median 1268, moving p95 5505 counts/s. cutoff = 0.05 + 0.0005 x speed.
beta is the whole design: still, the filter is nearly frozen (tau 3.2 s); at the p95 of moving.csv it has opened 56x, past the fixed EMA it replaces.
The deadband stage is not on this plot and cannot be: a sine under the threshold comes out as silence, not as an attenuated sine.
